verdict.language_detail: PML (Prague Markup Language) XML annotation layer — morphological data layer (.cz.m) from PCEDT
verdict.provenance_detail: PDT/PCEDT morphological annotation layer generated by Czech tagger, part of Prague Czech-English Dependency Treebank (PCEDT)
verdict.purpose: Morphological annotation layer for Czech text (WSJ article wsj1612 translated to Czech), storing word forms, lemmas, and morphological tags in PML XML format as part of the Prague Czech-English Dependency Treebank corpus.
